avis.texte: Love love love this cleanser! I use it with the Eve Lom facial cloth and my skin is glowing! The scent of the cleanser is wonderful. It smells like I'm getting a specialty facial at a spa! It does not clog your pores and my dry skin has improved.

Great product! Gentle cream cleanser that removes make up. Smells like a lovely green tea! Not a horrible scent which others are reporting. Great for travel because its like a gel cream and it won't leak.

I was really excited to tey this cleaning balm out but was quickly deterred. I opened it and proceeded to apply it. The scent was overpowering (kind of like a medicinal, herbal scent). So much so, I just rinsed it off. I didn't even really try it. I'm not one to be to particular about scent in skincare but this was NOT it.

avis.titre: One of my favorite cleansing balms of all time
avis.texte: This Eve Lom Cleansing Balm with the linen cloth is like magic for your skin. It's one of my favorite cleansing balms for results, over my Tatcha and Elemis. You will see results if you use the Eve Lom balm per the directions!

Was TOTALLY surprised by how much I love this product! I'm the lady that always wants "new" so for me to re-order you know it has to be fantastic. The best part of this product is the super soft exfoliation in it. This actually calms the facial skin (and neck) while cleansing and doesn't feel abrasive after at all! If you are looking for a "scrub" this isn't it. The smell is soft and aromatic like a spa visit and when rubbing it in, I actually feel my face thank me. Takes off make-up and soothes without being greasy. A must buy!
This product is amazing. It's like rubbing the most moisturizing olive oil on your face but not greasy. The cleanser left my face shining and feeling so soft.
